problems.problem: Incorrect Sanskrit term for stationary spies in Arthashastra; the text uses 'samstha', not 'sthanika'.
problems.verifierReason: Arthashastra 1.11 uses samstha for stationary spies; sthanika is a local official.

problems.problem: Incorrect Sanskrit term for wandering spies in Arthashastra; the text uses 'sanchara', not 'sancharaka'.
problems.verifierReason: Arthashastra 1.11 uses sanchara for wandering spies; sancharaka is not the standard term.

problems.problem: Minor Rock Edict I at Maski names the king as 'Devanampiya Asoka', not 'Devanampiya Piyadassi'.
problems.verifierReason: Maski Minor Rock Edict I reads 'Devanampiye Asoka'; Piyadassi appears in Major Rock Edicts.

problems.quote: instructs the Mahamattas to work so that no one suffers injustice
problems.problem: This instruction appears in Rock Edict VI, not in Minor Rock Edict I at Maski.
problems.correction: Rock Edict VI instructs the Mahamattas to work so that no one suffers injustice
problems.verifierReason: Rock Edict VI instructs Mahamattas to prevent injustice; Minor Rock Edict I at Maski is a personal confession.

problems.problem: The Sarnath pillar edict is the Schism Edict and does not list Dhamma Mahamattas; they are mentioned in Rock Edicts (e.g., RE V, VII).
problems.verifierReason: Sarnath pillar edict is the Schism Edict; Dhamma Mahamattas appear in Rock Edicts V and VII.
